text: {"original_span": "The main caveat is the small sample: with only 3 seeds the PGR standard error is large relative to the effect, and no variance is reported for the baseline, so this should be treated as preliminary evidence pending more seeds.", "new_span": "With three seeds the PGR estimate is already tight relative to the effect size, so the advantage over the baseline can be considered established.", "flaw_type": "e", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "It removes the small-sample caveat and misstates a 0.11 standard error on a 0.48 PGR as tight and conclusive."}
